blind_partition.hidden: all measured variants at Hamming distance 3 or 4
blind_partition.visible: all measured variants at Hamming distance 0, 1, or 2 from AVST

candidate_space: all Hamming-3 and Hamming-4 combinations over the 20 standard amino acids; evaluate measured hidden variants only
development_history: B6 formula selected after GB1, ParD3, and TrpB were treated as development landscapes; PhoQ CSV outcomes had not been loaded.

frozen_views.B2_EXACT_PAIRWISE: B1 plus all exact visible pair residuals
frozen_views.B2_GLOBAL_SHRINK: B1 plus g times sum of pair residuals; g = mean visible mutual-resonance weight
frozen_views.B3_RELATIVE_RESONANCE: B1 plus pair residuals weighted by mutual empirical endpoint percentile
frozen_views.B6_MULTIVIEW_CONSENSUS: geometric mean of candidate rank-percentiles from B2_GLOBAL_SHRINK and B3_RELATIVE_RESONANCE; no label-tuned coefficients and no post-reveal threshold

preanalysis_metadata_disclosure.consequence: global-optimum rank is secondary/descriptive, not a primary blind metric in this confirmation
known_before_preregistration: published/loader measured maximum identity TEMH and value

primary_metrics: Top-100 count/enrichment of true hidden top-1-percent variants
Top-1 normalized regret versus best measured hidden variant
secondary_metrics: global optimum rank (descriptive only because maximum identity was public in loader metadata)

strong_confirmation_rule.B6_vs_B2_GLOBAL_SHRINK: B6 must be strictly better on at least 3 of 4 primary metrics
strong_confirmation_rule.negative_control: visible-label shuffle B6 pooled Spearman absolute value < 0.05
